personal.name: Abubakar Z.
personal.bio: I am a results-driven Digital Marketing Executive with hands-on experience in SEO, content optimization, lead generation, WordPress management, and AI-powered marketing workflows. Proven ability to increase organic traffic by up to 40% and improve brand visibility by 70-90% through data-driven strategies and community marketing. My expertise includes building targeted prospect lists, managing CRM pipelines, and leveraging AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini to optimize business growth and acquire high-quality B2B prospects.

services.title: SEO & Organic Growth
services.shortDesc: End-to-end SEO initiatives including technical audits, keyword research, on-page optimization, and SERP dominance.
services.fullDesc: Comprehensive SEO campaigns that scale organic reach. By conducting thorough competitor analysis, content gap identification, schema markup, and executing data-driven technical fixes, I have consistently driven 25-40% organic traffic growth across competitive niches.
deliverables: In-depth Technical SEO Audits & Core Web Vitals Fixes
Competitor Keyword Gap & Intent Mapping (Ahrefs & SEMrush)
On-Page Optimization, Meta Taxonomies & Schema Architecture
AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) & Entity-based Topical Authority
Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Search Console Performance Tracking

services.title: B2B Lead Generation & Outreach
services.shortDesc: Multi-channel B2B lead generation campaigns targeting high-converting decision-makers.
services.fullDesc: End-to-end prospecting and outbound strategy. Using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, SalesQL, and modern CRM pipelines, I build hyper-targeted prospect databases. With rigorous A/B tested copy, I have reduced bounce rates by 60-70% and improved response rates by 30-40%.
deliverables: High-Intent ICP & Prospect List Building (Apollo & SalesQL)
LinkedIn Sales Navigator Outreach & Connection Cadences
Cold Email Sequences with A/B Subject & Body Testing
Deliverability Optimization & Spam Protection (60-70% Bounce Cut)
